recipe.appearance_status: The KiCad TO-252-2 display model approximates the drawing with two full leads, a short centre stub and a metal tab; its overall bounds are 9.9 x 6.5 x 2.32 mm. The catalogue footprint remains TO-252-3_TabPin2. Stub dimensions, finish and marking are approximate; not a manufacturing model. The family PDF is stored with electronic_transistor_to_251_mosfet_n_channel_enhancement_mode_100_volt_9_4_amp_infineon_technologies_irfu120npbf; this part has no separate local PDF.
